premise.premise: A child invents a cartoon animal hero. The hero has one weakness that turns out to be useful.

item.title: Omar's Story
item.passage: Omar drew a pretty cat for his short story. The cat was lost in a big garden. A brave dog came to help the cat. The dog was afraid because the water was cold. He did not want to swim in the lake. Because he walked on the grass, the dog found the lost cat. The cat was happy to go home with Omar.

item.title: Omar's Picture
item.passage: Omar drew a big cat on some paper. The big cat was afraid of loud noise. Omar stopped drawing because he was hungry. He put his picture on the table and went to eat. item.title: Omar's Comic
item.passage: Omar sat in his bedroom and drew a funny comic. His story was about a brave cat who liked water. The cat sat on the grass because he wanted to find his lost ball. He looked around and saw his friend Mia near the river. The cat took a long net because Mia dropped her bag into the river. He got the bag out with the net quickly. Mia was very happy and thanked the clever cat.
